    t1.beneregistry AS "Beneficiary Registry ID", 
    t1.distequityidx AS "Calculated Equity Value",

    "Beneficiary Registry ID" ASC;

events.sql:
SELECT 
    t1.beneregistry AS "Beneficiary Registry ID", 
    t1.distequityidx AS "Calculated Equity Value", 
    CASE 
        WHEN t1.distequityidx > 0.5 THEN 'Resource Distribution Inequity' 
        ELSE 'Normal Distribution' 
    END AS "Distribution Status",
    (t2.impactmetrics->'population'->>'affected')::int AS "Disaster-Affected Population"
FROM 
    beneficiariesandassessments AS t1
JOIN 
    disasterevents AS t2 ON t1.benedistref = t2.distregistry
ORDER BY 
    "Beneficiary Registry ID" ASC;
